info.title: Kalixo Distribution API
info.description:
The Kalixo Distribution API lets partners browse their product catalog, place and track digital gift-card orders (single or bulk), and monitor their wallet balance. All v2 ordering is asynchronous: place an order, then poll it until the codes are delivered.

Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header; include it when you contact support. Responses after authentication also carry `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

get.description: Returns a simple success payload so you can verify that the Kalixo API is reachable from your network. Requires your `x-api-key` and a whitelisted IP address — contact your account manager to issue a key and allowlist your egress IPs before calling this endpoint.

Returns catalog products as one row per country. Regional products share the same `productCode` across rows and differ by `countryCode` / `sku`. Filter by country/language/brand/category/tag (comma-separated for multiple) and paginate with skip/take (take max 100).

post.description:
Creates an order asynchronously. The response returns immediately with an `orderId` and a `processing` status, plus an `estimatedReadyAt` timestamp that indicates when to start polling for codes. Larger orders receive a later `estimatedReadyAt`.

Send the catalog `productCode` and the `price` you expect to pay (used to validate the order). For fixed-price products the price must match the current catalog price; for open-denomination products send the chosen amount within the allowed range.

Send `country` on each line: the `countryCode` of the catalog row. It is required when the product's `availableCountries` has more than one entry.

`externalOrderCode` is your idempotency key. Repeating a code you already used returns `202` with the existing order and its current status; no second order is created. If two requests with the same new code arrive at the same moment, one of them can get `409`: fetch the order with `GET /orders/{externalOrderCode}`.

202.description: Order accepted. Also returned, with the existing order, when you repeat an `externalOrderCode`.

400.description: Validation or order rejection. See the Errors guide for the full message catalogue.

403.description: API ordering disabled for your account.

409.description: Another request with the same `externalOrderCode` was being placed at the same moment. The order exists: fetch it with `GET /orders/{externalOrderCode}` instead of retrying.

422.description: Order limit exceeded, insufficient wallet funds, or product not available for purchase.

502.description: Order could not be created or is temporarily unavailable.

get.description:
Fetches an order by the UUID `orderId` returned on placement or by your `externalOrderCode`.

Redemption codes are returned when status is `completed` (all units) or `partially_completed` (delivered units only). While `processing` you receive `estimatedReadyAt` and a status message; `failed` returns a reason.

**partially_completed** includes `delivered`, `total`, and `products[].codes` for every code that was delivered (see the **Partial delivery with codes** response example).

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: The UUID orderId returned on placement, or your externalOrderCode.

200.description: The order and its current status.

value.message: Order is still processing

get.description: Returns your current wallet balances per currency, plus a low-balance flag and the configured threshold.

Sandbox only. Returns the Kalixo Test products with their expected outcome and a `sampleOrderLine` you can send to `POST /orders` as-is. The same products appear in `GET /catalog/products` with brand **Kalixo Test** and `isSandboxProduct: true`. On the production API this endpoint returns `404`.

200.description: Kalixo Test products and expected outcomes.

CatalogProductNotFound.description: Product not found in your active catalog.

OrderNotFound.description: Order not found for the supplied reference.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded. Wait `Retry-After` seconds, then retry.

SandboxOnly.description: Called on the production API. Sandbox helpers exist on the sandbox only.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Your Kalixo API key. Send it in the `x-api-key` header on every request.

X-Request-Id.description: Unique ID of the request. Include it when you contact support. If you send your own `X-Request-Id` (8 to 64 letters, digits, `-` or `_`), Kalixo echoes it back.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current 60-second window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the current window resets.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (429 responses only).

status.description: Always `ok` when the API is reachable.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the response was generated.

DenominationType.description: `fixed` products have a set price; `open` products accept any amount within a range.

sku.description: Locale SKU in the form `{CC}-{LL}-{productCode}` (e.g. GB-EN-10020000213575).

descriptionHtml.description: Same as `description`, with the original HTML markup.

tnc.description: Terms and conditions as plain text.

tncHtml.description: Same as `tnc`, with the original HTML markup.

redemptionInstructionsHtml.description: Same as `redemptionInstructions`, with the original HTML markup.

productCode.description: The product code you order with - a stable 14-digit catalog identifier, identical across sandbox and production.

shortName.description: Short display name or abbreviation for the product.

price.description: Selling price in minor units (e.g. pennies).

buyingPrice.description: Your buying price in minor units.

discountAmount.description: Your discount amount in minor units (sell price minus your buying price, or the monetary equivalent of your commission rate).

discountPercentage.description: Your commission rate as a percentage of the sell price.

currencyMismatch.description: True when your buying currency differs from the product's selling currency.

isSandboxProduct.description: `true` for Kalixo Test products, which exist in the sandbox only. Always `false` in production.

countryCode.description: ISO country code of this catalog row (the market). Regional products return one row per available country with the same productCode. Send it as `country` on the order line.

redeemable.description: Country or market where the product can be redeemed (derived from `countryCode`).

status.description: Product availability in the catalog (e.g. active, inactive, preorder).

promotion.description: **Planned, not returned yet.** True when a promotion applies to this product.

promotionType.description: **Planned, not returned yet.** Kind of promotional offer.

promotionDetails.description: **Planned, not returned yet.** Offer detail (e.g. percentage, amount off, or bonus item description).

promotionStartDate.description: **Planned, not returned yet.** First day the promotion applies.

promotionEndDate.description: **Planned, not returned yet.** Last day the promotion applies.

serviceFee.description: **Planned, not returned yet.** True when a service fee applies to this product.

serviceFeeType.description: **Planned, not returned yet.** How the service fee is calculated.

serviceFeeValue.description: **Planned, not returned yet.** Fee rate or amount. For `Percentage`, the percentage of sell price (e.g. `"2.5"` for 2.5%). For `Amount`, the fixed fee in minor units (e.g. `"250"` for £2.50).

sku.description: Market SKU for this country row: `{CC}-{LL}-{productCode}`. Same productCode can appear once per country.

availableCountries.description: Every country this productCode can be ordered for. When it has more than one entry, each order line must say which one with `country` (or a market `sku`).

price.description: Expected unit price in minor units. For fixed products this must match the catalog price; for open-denomination products this is the chosen amount within the allowed range.

currency.description: Optional line currency. Defaults to the order-level currency.

sku.description: Optional market SKU (`{CC}-{LL}-{productCode}`) from the catalog row. Its country prefix is used when `country` is omitted.

country.description: ISO country code of the market to fulfil: the `countryCode` of the catalog row you are selling. Required when the product's `availableCountries` has more than one entry and `sku` does not carry the country. Must be one of `availableCountries`. Safe to send for every line.

externalOrderCode.description: Your unique reference for this order. Acts as the idempotency key.

price.description: Optional expected order total in minor units. If sent, must equal the sum of (line unit price × quantity).

balances.description: Balance per currency as a decimal amount in major units (`196.01` is GBP 196.01), unlike prices, which are in minor units.

lowBalance.description: True when any balance is below the low-balance threshold, or when you have no balance.

status.description: Always `processing` for a new order. When you repeat an `externalOrderCode` you already used, this is the existing order's current status. Codes are never included here: fetch them with `GET /orders/{reference}`.

estimatedReadyAt.description: Approximate time the codes should be ready. Poll the order after this time.

products.description: Present when status is `completed` or `partially_completed`. Each line includes `codes` for delivered units only.

balances.description: Balance per currency as a decimal amount in major units (`196.01` is GBP 196.01), unlike prices, which are in minor units.

lowBalance.description: True when any balance is below `threshold`, or when you have no balance.

threshold.description: Low-balance threshold in major units. Crossing below it triggers an email alert.

Error.description: Standard error response. See the Errors concept page for the complete message catalogue.

error.description: Short label for the status (for example `Bad Request`, `Not Found`). Omitted on some `500` responses.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. May include the productCode you sent.

productCode.description: Order with this productCode in the sandbox.

expectedOutcome.description: What the order does in the sandbox.
